messages:
olivia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners + timelines for the testing/evals items: regression prompt set, KV/load test, and a scoped chaos drill. I'll collate into the ticket. Can people volunteer?
marco: I can own the KV/load automation. estimate 2w to add harness + infra job. Need a perf dataset and threshold targets.
jess: I'll take the regression promptset + eval integration. Plan: add promptset to repo, wire into nightly evals, add gating alerts for score drops. Targeting EOD 2026-03-25 for PR.
ryan: I will run the chaos drill and update the runbook. Scope: core routing + fallback logic we saw fail. Monthly drills thereafter. I propose first drill 2026-04-05.
oncall-bot: Incident Bot: postmortem link posted: https://redwood/example/postmortem/INC-2026-042. Assigned temporary ticket JIRA-3572.
triage-bot: Triage: created sub-tickets: JIRA-3572 (kv-load, owner=marco), JIRA-3573 (promptset, owner=jess), JIRA-3574 (chaos drill, owner=ryan).
marco: rough infra plan: spin up 3 nodes, run steady-state + burst at 200 rps for 15m. Will add runbook entry and pass/fail criteria.
jess: promptset approach: convert the failing flows into 120 prompts, add expected buckets, run via eval-harness. will create PR and link ticket.
ryan: drill playbook changes: document rollback criteria, fallback model mapping, and post-drill smoke checklist. Also will coordinate with oncall team to reserve window.
olivia: thanks — can everyone add a one-line due date to their JIRA comment today? I'll create a master checklist and schedule the first cross-team sync for next Tuesday. :spiral_calendar: 
marco: done — added due 2026-03-30 to JIRA-3572. :white_check_mark:
jess: added due 2026-03-25 to JIRA-3573 and linked promptset PR number in the ticket. :rocket:
ryan: added due 2026-04-05 to JIRA-3574 and proposed drill window 2026-04-06 1500-1700 UTC.
olivia: perfect. I'll add the cron entries once PRs land. sample cron for nightly regression run:```
0 03 * * * /opt/redwood/evals/run_regression.sh --suite postmortem-2026 --notify #eng-oncall
```
marco: load run command I'll standardize and publish:```
run-load --target kv-cluster --rps 200 --duration 15m --check latency90<200ms
```
jess: eval command to add to harness:```
eval-harness --suite promptset-postmortem --model redwood/curated-v1 --threshold 0.86
```
olivia: small ask — add a smoke assertion that checks that routing fallback actually routes to the cheaper variant (we saw hot path cost > fallback). put it in PR comments.
ryan: will add that to drill checklist and the smoke script.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: JIRA-3573 PR review reminder in 48h.
olivia: thanks all. I'll post the master checklist and invite for Tuesday sync. :thumbsup:
